title: Towards Robust Time Series Learning via Capacity-Centric Modulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39489v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sample-level reliability heterogeneity is common in deep time series learning. Standard training pipelines apply a uniform regularization setting to all samples, which can under-regularize corrupted samples and over-restrict clean samples. Common robustness approaches filter observations in data space or impose priors on latent representations. We propose Capacity-Centric Modulation (CCM) as a complementary, sample-adaptive regularization principle. Under this principle, we introduce SACM (Sample-Adaptive Capacity Modulation), a task-agnostic framework that exploits spectral sparsity to assign sample-wise dropout probabilities along internal activation paths. SACM integrates into existing backbones without architectural redesign and preserves the deterministic inference pipeline. Across 301 real-world dataset-backbone pairs covering 9 forecasting, 32 classification, and 4 anomaly-detection datasets, SACM reduces forecasting MSE by 6.7% o

translated_title: 通过以容量为中心的调制迈向鲁棒的时间序列学习
translated_abstract: 样本级可靠性异质性在深度时间序列学习中十分常见。标准训练流程对所有样本采用统一的正则化设置，这可能导致对受损样本的正则化不足，而对干净样本过度限制。常见的鲁棒性方法要么在数据空间中过滤观测值，要么在潜在表示上施加先验。我们提出以容量为中心的调制（Capacity-Centric Modulation, CCM），作为一种互补的、样本自适应的正则化原则。在该原则下，我们引入SACM（样本自适应容量调制，Sample-Adaptive Capacity Modulation），这是一个任务无关的框架，利用频谱稀疏性沿内部激活路径为每个样本分配不同的dropout概率。SACM无需重新设计架构即可集成到现有骨干网络中，并保持确定性推理流程。在涵盖9个预测、32个分类和4个异常检测数据集的301个真实世界数据集-骨干网络组合上，SACM将预测MSE降低了6.7%……
tldr: 提出样本自适应容量调制框架SACM，利用频谱稀疏性为每个样本分配不同的dropout概率，无需修改网络架构即可显著提升时间序列预测、分类和异常检测任务的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: SACM is a task-agnostic, sample-adaptive capacity modulation framework that leverages spectral sparsity to assign sample-wise dropout probabilities, enhancing robustness in time series forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection without architectural redesign.
